Adoption and setup accessibility contract checks pass; full rendered timer and app-wide adoption acceptance are not claimed. 2026-10-26 timer navigation token pass: the empty-practice Browse practices link and completed-session contextual Dispatch link now share buttonClasses primary styling instead of hand-rolled palette, padding and radius utilities. Link hrefs, labels, overlay-close callbacks and anchor semantics are unchanged. This is two bounded action sites, not app-wide completion; SCAN-1133 remains open. Timer directory follow-up: remaining literal xl/2xl radii in on-air controls and feedback panels now use control/card tokens; Stop & Log in both engines and compact More settings use the existing ghost Button, and the Dispatch archive empty-state action uses buttonClasses. Custom pressed preset tiles, mode tabs, mode-accent actions, overlay scrims/close controls and branded mastheads retain their distinct semantics. Aggregate row remains open; no visual or whole-app completion claim.
